bucket_labels.ballot: Voted at the ballot — capital debt exclusions
bucket_labels.town_meeting: Voted at Town Meeting — annual budget articles
bucket_labels.ratepayer: Paid by ratepayers, not the property-tax levy
bucket_labels.revolving: Revolving funds (paid by users of the service)
bucket_labels.other: Trust, donation, and small fundraising funds

_meta.ballot_caveat: Captures direct project spend in the A-numbered capital funds. Annual debt-service bond payments on the same ballot-approved projects are paid out of GENERAL FUND - TOWN ($14.2M to U.S. Bank in FY26 across many bond series) and cannot be split bond-by-bond without an external debt schedule. So 'ballot' is a floor, not a ceiling, on what voters directly authorized.

tm_carve_out.qualifier: Ledger is vendor checks only; payroll (the largest discretionary line in any operating budget) is paid through a separate payroll system and does not appear in these rows. The 14.3% discretionary figure is therefore for vendor spend only, not total budget choice.

top_movers.note: Light Dept wholesale, ratepayer not tax

snow_removal_overrun.note: Identified by the live page; will need a supplemental appropriation at a Special Town Meeting to close out FY26 books.
